# heavyq

> Priority, resource-aware queue for heavy shell commands (tests, builds) on workstations running many AI coding agents at once. Single Go binary, no daemon: priority tickets (1-9, FIFO within a priority), heavy/light flock slots, a RAM/load gate, result caching and coalescing keyed by git tree, offload to spare machines over SSH by exact commit, a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that wraps heavy commands automatically, `status --json`, and a loopback web dashboard (`heavyq dash`), and per-repo proof gates (`heavyq gate status` / `gate run`: is this exact code proven?) that work with zero config (a `ready` gate is detected from go.mod, package.json, pytest config or Cargo.toml) and `heavyq init [--agents-md]` to write heavyq.toml and tell agents to run the gate before saying done.

Typical use: `heavyq <prio> [--lane NAME] [--light] [--cache] [--max-wait DUR] -- <command>`. Exit codes are stable API: the command's own code when it ran; 2 usage/setup error; 75 `--max-wait` elapsed; 76 remotes unreachable; 77 remote preparation failed; 78 cancelled by an operator; 255 remote connection lost mid-run. `heavyq gate status [name]` exits 0 when the code checked out now is proven by the gate in heavyq.toml (or the detected default `ready (detected)` when there is no file), 1 when not, 2 on usage error; `heavyq gate run [name]` proves it. `heavyq init` writes heavyq.toml from the detection (exit 1 if it exists unless `--force`; `--print` to stdout); `--agents-md` adds an idempotent section to AGENTS.md: before saying a task is done run `heavyq gate run ready`; exit 1 fix and re-run; exit 75 queue busy, retry later, never bypass heavyq.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LysCongThanh/heavyq/main/README.md): install, quickstart, flags, configuration table, exit codes, platform support
- [Claude Code hook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LysCongThanh/heavyq/main/docs/claude-code.md): how the PreToolUse hook rewrites commands and what it relies on
- [Gates (heavyq.toml)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LysCongThanh/heavyq/main/docs/gates.md): per-repo gate format, the zero-config detected gate and `heavyq init`, `gate status` (`--json` schema, exit codes) and `gate run`, what counts as proven, trust model
- [Dashboard, JSON snapshot and control API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LysCongThanh/heavyq/main/docs/dashboard.md): security model, `/api/v1` endpoints, `status --json` schema
- [Example config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LysCongThanh/heavyq/main/examples/config.toml): annotated TOML
